Paired figures describe separate homes. Building plans cover the first–eighth floors. The original master-plan contextual facade differs from the main Jenna elevations and remains visible in its unchanged spread. Regional and community Sharjah-airport estimates conflict. Confirm the contracted unit, balcony size, drawing revision and final finishes.

review.imagery: Root reviewed all26 brochure index spreads and all9 extracted scenes. Eight gallery entries use Jenna main elevations, courtyard, pool, living/bedroom concepts and two Aljada context scenes. The differently styled contextual facade on master-plan spread15 is excluded from the project gallery. Native source image index1 is used for the living-room scene, excluding the unrelated portrait. Cover crop positioning will be checked in browser.
review.floorPlans: Root reviewed all10 staged whole spreads and all9 enlarged visible numeric panels. All9 apartment ranges were manually read from final printed footers. Nine delivered choices retain every type, all eight floors and both master maps with unedited notices and physical-page links. Masked older maximum-only text does not override the displayed ranges.
review.location: Root reviewed the red Jenna1 footprint, regional physical5 and community physical6. Regional3/20-minute estimates are recorded, with the conflicting community5-minute Sharjah-airport figure explicit. No entrance coordinate, transport mode or kilometre distance inferred.
